description: Two columns + a full-width header in the middle of the page (not at the top) — tests spanning vs columnar lines and the bands in reading order.

expected.note: Construction fact: 4 columnar lines top-left (y=700..640, x=72), 4 top-right (y=700..640, x=310), 1 full-width header (y=560, x=72, wider than 70% of the text block), 4 columnar bottom-left (y=500..440, x=72), 4 bottom-right (y=500..440, x=310). splitSpanningLines() should separate exactly 1 spanning line; detectColumns() on the remaining 16 columnar lines should find a gutter x∈[~240,310] identical top and bottom. Reading order: the upper band (left then right), the header, the lower band (left then right). totalItemCount=19 (not 17): pdf.js inserts an empty synthetic TextItem at every mid-stream font size change (Tf between Tj) — here 2 transitions (10->14 before the header, 14->10 after), hence 17 lines + 2 empty = 19 (confirmed empirically, see also layout-statblock-* and layout-2col-sidebar).
